name: Boney Metal Works
old_description: 20 + years of experience in the welding and fabrication trade. we provide quality craftsmanship for the domestic and commercial markets.
about:
Boney Metal Works operates from Loveland, Colorado. The company was founded by Sam Boney, who grew up in Northern Idaho and began working with metal at age 19. After completing welding courses at North Idaho College, Boney gained experience at various firms before establishing his own shop. The business is owner-operated, with Boney overseeing daily operations.

The shop specializes in stainless steel and aluminum welding, custom fabrication, water jet cutting, forming, and turnkey manufacturing. In-house CAD capabilities support design and detailing from concept through production. The facility handles projects of varying scale, from small custom pieces to larger commercial jobs, though specific capacity figures are not disclosed.

Boney Metal Works serves both domestic and commercial markets, providing fabrication and welding services for residential clients as well as business customers. The company does not list specific industry verticals or named accounts in its public materials.

Boney emphasizes a personal commitment to precision and communication, citing over two decades of trade experience and a focus on detailed project management as factors that distinguish the shop. The founder’s background in racing and off-road riding in Northern Colorado reflects a hands-on approach to metalwork.
